name: Витрина «За Энериум»: пятеро «Под песком» — донатный сет цикла III (ADR-0021, ADR-0022, ADR-0023, п. 9). Безликие — без лица (ADR-0023, п. 10). Тот же рецепт, что у «Менял» (jobs/donat-showcase.json): глубокий промт персонажа, кадр героя по пояс, корпус вправо, лица нет — гладкая тьма в капюшоне, зелёный песок времени с краёв плаща. Место — Арена Сеймура на севере: клетки и ходы под ней, Храм Огня в скале, колыбель севера (свод, «Норден-Вильд»). Свет — алый Нитриума (школа Огня) и зелёный Энериума. Источники: docs/content/герои/состав-героев.md, сет III «Под песком»; главы — design/ui/roster.js, c3-59…c3-63.
style: Art style: hand-painted stylized dark-fantasy game art for a mobile RPG. Painterly digital illustration with visible, confident brush strokes and simplified planar shapes, crisp rim light on edges, strong readable silhouettes, deep near-black shadows. Epic, precious, regal: rich materials — old gold, dark bronze, black stone, deep green velvet. Light tells the story: a few strong sources — crystals and cracks that glow from within — throw colored light upward, the light comes from below. Cold green light of time-crystals against warm gold. Fine sand and dust motes float in the light. Moderate detail, clean readable forms. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime. Match the brushwork, lighting and color handling of the attached style reference images, but do NOT copy their subjects, objects, letters or composition.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no real-world alphabets, no runes or markings that look like writing, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no border or frame around the picture, no gems or badges of rank. No bodies, no skulls, no blood. Only one character in the foreground; a person has exactly two arms and two hands. Not stiff, not passive, not posing like a mannequin, not a statue.

heroes.frame:
Draw exactly one image in a single pass: no alternative versions, no second attempts, no text in the reply. Format: vertical hero card portrait, 4:5. A close, heroic half-body portrait from the waist or hips up, three-quarter view; no knees, no legs, no feet in the frame. The camera is a little below the hero's chest and looks slightly up, so the hero towers — a legend, not an extra. The hero's body is turned toward the right side of the picture, toward unseen enemies beyond the right edge. The hero is caught at the peak of an action that shows who they were; the pose carries weight and intent. The head in the upper third; the lower quarter may be darker because the card puts the name there. Rich atmospheric background that tells where the hero lived, with depth and soft focus, darker than the character. Light comes from below; rim light separates the figure from the background.

This hero is one of the Faceless: a soul of the distant past whose face has long been worn away, and who does not remember who they were. Where the face should be there is only a smooth, soft darkness, like shadow pooled inside the hood or head-covering — the face rubbed away like the face of an old coin. No eyes, no glowing eyes, no nose, no mouth, no mask, no skull, no features at all in that darkness. Everything else about the hero is vivid and specific: the clothing, the silhouette, the tools of the trade and above all the hands — alive, strong and expressive; the hands and the trade tell who they were. Fine green sand of time drifts from the edges of the cloak and from the fingertips and floats upward — the mark of the timeless. The rarity is the highest in the game: the portrait feels precious and regal, with old gold highlights and deep green light.

jobs.title: Кольбейн Сборщик Дани — Безликий, фармер, донатный сет III «Под песком», 1-й (c3-59)
jobs.source: Главы c3-59: «Звон дани» — монета о монету, камень о монету, ладонь знает вес без весов, песок в мешках; «Последняя ставка» — дань с Арены золотом и карстом, ярлы ели с его руки, одна своя монета — единственная ставка. Решение агента: медвежий капюшон, цепь сборщика, монета с дырой на шнурке. К выгрузке — design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c3-59.jpg, без mirror.
jobs.subject: Subject: Kolbein the Tribute-Collector, a man of the northern lands, one of the Faceless. Who he is: he collected the tribute of the great northern Arena: the world brought to the north its quarrels, its fighters and its bets, and paid in gold and in carst stones; the jarls despised him and ate from his hand. He never placed a bet — a collector bets on everyone. Right now he weighs a heavy purse of tribute in his open palm, without scales, listening to the coins ring. Character: cold, shrewd and unflappable — the only quiet man above a roaring crowd; his head tilted a little as he listens to the coins, his shoulders relaxed and sure. Pose, the moment of the count: the camera is low; he stands turned toward the right on a stone gallery above the arena. He has exactly two arms: his near hand is raised at chest height, palm up, tossing a heavy leather purse so that gold coins and small scarlet stones spill out and ring against each other in the air; his far hand holds the strap of a big sack of tribute slung over his shoulder. Details that tell his story: (1) a heavy coat of dark red wool trimmed with fur, a wide belt hung with many small pouches and blank tally-sticks; (2) a deep hood of black bear fur frames the smooth darkness where his face should be; (3) the sacks at his feet are stained with arena sand; (4) a thick golden chain of office across his chest; (5) a single copper coin with a hole in it hangs on a cord around his neck — his one and only bet. Place: a torch-lit stone gallery above the arena of the north: the sand, banners and a roaring crowd blurred in soft focus below. Scarlet light of fire stones from braziers below, glints of gold, faint green time-light at his feet.

jobs.title: Ранва Ключница Клеток — Безликая, контроль (на контроль), Огонь, донатный сет III «Под песком», 2-я (c3-60)
jobs.source: Главы c3-60: «Голоса из клеток» — голоса, а не лица, связка тяжёлая, как ведро, холод железа в ладони; «Открытая клетка» — сорок лет ключей, ни одного зверя не звала по имени, одна клетка открыта с того дня, как вождь отпер её для клеймёного зверя. Решение агента: оковы из алого огня — её контроль, перчатки со следами когтей. К выгрузке — design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c3-60.jpg, без mirror.
jobs.subject: Subject: Ranva the Cage-Keeper, a woman of the northern lands, one of the Faceless, a controller of the Fire school. Who she is: for forty years she carried the keys to the cages and passages beneath the great northern Arena: she let the beasts out into the light and drove them back again. She knew every beast by its voice and never called one by name — the ones you name are harder to let out. Right now she commands a beast beyond the right edge to stay down, and scarlet fire binds it. Character: stern, fearless and quietly compassionate — the calm authority of someone even beasts obey; her shoulders squared, her head tilted as if she is listening to their breathing. Pose, the moment of command: the camera is low; she stands turned toward the right in a dark stone passage. She has exactly two arms: her near hand is thrust out toward the right, fingers spread, and chains of glowing scarlet fire uncoil from her palm toward the beast beyond the right edge (Fire control); her far hand holds up a huge iron ring of cage keys, heavy as a bucket. Details that tell her story: (1) a heavy leather hood frames the smooth darkness where her face should be; (2) a leather apron and thick iron-studded gauntlets scarred by claws; (3) the keys are large and blackened, each one different; (4) straw and sand on the floor, deep claw marks on the stone; (5) behind her one cage door of iron bars stands wide open — it has not been locked for years. Place: the cage passages beneath the arena: iron bars, the dark hulking shapes of great beasts behind them, sand trickling from the ceiling. Scarlet firelight from torches and from cracks in the floor below, faint green time-light at her feet.

jobs.title: Жрец Бранд — Безликий, контроль (на дебаффы), Огонь, донатный сет III «Под песком», 3-й (c3-61)
jobs.source: Главы c3-61: «Жар в скале» — скала тёплая, как спина быка, открытое пламя в проёме, видное с моря и с гор, алый камень тяжелее, чем кажется; «Без объяснений» — решал, в чей второй клинок вставить камень, валил победившего и пропускал проигравшего и не объяснял. Решение агента: конус алого света, в котором угли стынут в пепел, — его ослабление; клинок без камня у груди. К выгрузке — design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c3-61.jpg, без mirror.
jobs.subject: Subject: Brand, priest of the Temple of Fire, a man of the northern lands, one of the Faceless, a controller of the Fire school who weakens his foes. Who he is: the Temple of Fire is cut into the rock above the Arena, its open flame seen from the sea and from the mountains; he decided into whose second blade the scarlet fire stone would be set — the stone kindles only what is already in a person. Sometimes he failed the winner and passed the loser, and he never explained. Right now he lifts a scarlet fire stone and passes judgment: its light falls on the enemy and withers their strength. Character: severe, unreadable and absolutely certain — he answers to no one; a straight back, a lifted head, total stillness. Pose, the moment of judgment: the camera is low; he stands turned toward the right on the rock stair of the temple. He has exactly two arms: his near hand lifts high a glowing scarlet stone between finger and thumb, and a narrow cone of red light pours from it toward the right edge, where drifting embers cool into grey ash (Fire, weakening); his far hand holds a long ceremonial blade against his chest, its empty stone socket waiting. Details that tell his story: (1) long robes of deep crimson and black, layered like folds of rock, the hem singed; (2) a tall stiff cowl of crimson cloth frames the smooth darkness where his face should be; (3) a necklace of empty golden stone settings; (4) his hands are calloused and marked by old burns; (5) the rock around him glows faintly with warmth, like the back of a bull. Place: the Temple of Fire cut into the rock above the Arena: a great open flame burns in a doorway of rock behind him, the sea and the mountains in soft focus far below. Scarlet firelight from the flame and from cracks in the rock below, faint green time-light at his feet.

jobs.title: Кетиль у Колыбели — Безликий, танк, Огонь, донатный сет III «Под песком», 4-й (c3-62)
jobs.source: Главы c3-62: «Шум сверху» — песок с потолка за ворот, стоял у двери годами, щит ни разу не опустил; «Где рождаются» — колыбель севера под Ареной, зверь из клеток пошёл на тепло и запах молока, дверь узкая, щит тяжёлый — не отступил. Решение агента: удар зверя о щит — алые искры, обереги для младенцев на поясе. К выгрузке — design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c3-62.jpg, без mirror.
jobs.subject: Subject: Ketil of the Cradle, a man of the northern lands, one of the Faceless, a guardian of the Fire school. Who he is: the cradle of the north lies beneath the Arena — here people are born in the same place where they die. He guarded its door for years, with the battle roaring overhead and newborn children behind him. On his last day a beast broke out of the cages and came through the passages toward the warmth and the smell of milk; the door was narrow and the shield was heavy; he did not step back. Right now he braces his great shield in the narrow doorway against the charge. Character: steadfast, immovable and protective — a wall of a man, grim and quiet resolve in every line of his body. Pose, the moment of the impact: the camera is low; he stands turned toward the right in a narrow stone doorway, his weight sunk low and driven forward. He has exactly two arms: his near arm drives a huge round shield of oak and iron forward toward the right, its rim blazing with scarlet fire where the blow lands, sparks bursting (Fire); his far hand grips a short heavy axe, held low and back. Details that tell his story: (1) a thick fur cloak and a hood of grey wool frame the smooth darkness where his face should be; (2) sand trickles from the ceiling onto his shoulders; (3) the shield is scarred by deep claw marks; (4) a string of tiny carved wooden charms for newborns hangs at his belt; (5) behind him, through the door, the soft warm light of a room with woven cradles, in soft focus. Place: the underground passages of the arena: rough stone walls, the narrow doorway, dust and sand in the air. Scarlet firelight from the shield and from braziers below, faint green time-light at his feet.

jobs.title: Асдис Повитуха — Безликая, лекарь, Огонь, донатный сет III «Под песком», 5-я (c3-63)
jobs.source: Главы c3-63: «Первый крик» — свои руки, скользкие и тёплые, самый первый крик, от которого всё становится правильным; «Тишина над песком» — принимала детей под Ареной, сорок лет над головой не стихало, в тишине ребёнок закричал так громко, что услышали наверху. Решение агента: младенец — только свёрток ткани, его не видно; лечащий огонь — кольцо тёплого света у рук. К выгрузке — design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c3-63.jpg, без mirror.
jobs.subject: Subject: Asdis the Midwife, a woman of the northern lands, one of the Faceless, a healer of the Fire school. Who she is: she delivered the children of the north beneath the Arena — in the same place where their fathers fell on the sand; she said the north is born and dies under one and the same cry. Right now she lifts a newborn toward the light, and healing firelight blooms around her hands. Character: warm, strong and unshakable — the calm center of every storm; her whole body leans toward the life she holds. Pose, the moment of the first cry: the camera is low; she stands turned toward the right. She has exactly two arms: both hands hold up a small bundle of warm woven cloth — the child is only a wrapped bundle, nothing of it is visible — lifted toward the right as if showing it to the world; a soft ring of golden-scarlet healing fire glows around her hands and the bundle (Fire, healing). Details that tell her story: (1) a long woollen headscarf and shawl of undyed wool frame the smooth darkness where her face should be; (2) sleeves rolled up over strong forearms, a leather belt with bundles of herbs, clean linen and a small knife; (3) a copper basin of warm water at her side, steam rising from it; (4) a string of amber beads around her wrist; (5) sand trickles from the ceiling while, far above, the arena roars. Place: the warm stone chamber of the cradle of the north beneath the arena: woven cradles and hanging lamps in soft focus. Warm scarlet-gold light from a hearth and from cracks in the floor below, faint green time-light at her feet.
